description: PaperezMCP - Academic Paper Research Made Easy - 6 Optimized Tools

tools.name: search_papers
tools.description: 🚨 CRITICAL: Use download_and_convert=True for full papers! Default returns only metadata/abstracts. Search academic papers across multiple databases with optional full-text extraction and download.

tools.name: search_authors
tools.description: Search for academic authors by name with citation metrics, h-index, and publication data from Google Scholar.

tools.name: extract_pdf_text
tools.description: Extract text from local PDF files using PyMuPDF with unlimited character support for academic papers.

tools.name: convert_pdf_to_markdown
tools.description: Convert single PDF to formatted markdown using zero-token conversion, preserving document structure and formatting.

tools.name: batch_convert_pdfs
tools.description: Convert all PDFs in a directory to markdown format with zero AI tokens, ideal for bulk processing research papers.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Get system status including API health for all academic databases and cache statistics for troubleshooting.

installation.command: claude mcp add -s project paperez-mcp -- uvx --from git+https://github.com/JosiahSiegel/paperez-mcp.git paperez-mcp
requirements: Internet connection for academic database access

usage.critical_warning: ⚠️ search_papers() returns only metadata by default! Use download_and_convert=True for full papers as files.
